notes: The public C++ scenario checks ordinary and If-Available acquisition publication guards plus exact ownership-tag relay. It verifies the acquisition request tag reaches Request Attribute Ownership Release, the release-denial tag reaches Attribute Ownership Unavailable, and the If-Wanted divestiture tag reaches Attribute Ownership Acquisition Notification. It also checks unpublishing remains rejected until ordinary/If-Available requests reach terminal callbacks and, after transfer, until acquisition notification delivery. The separately mapped acquisition-cancellation scenario verifies its cancellation callback. Primary and contract run under HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE; they are bounded API evidence, not independent tests, Lab validation, or conformance.
